before_snippet:
import sys
import urllib3

# On Python 3.9, urllib3 2.6.3 works fine; 2.7.0 does not support Python 3.9
# This snippet verifies urllib3 imports successfully on Python 3.9
if sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 9):
    # urllib3 2.7.0 dropped Python 3.9 support; attempting to import should fail
    # We simulate by checking the package metadata
    from importlib.metadata import version, requires
    v = version('urllib3')
    major, minor, patch = (int(x) for x in v.split('.')[:3])
    if major == 2 and minor >= 7:
        # Check requires-python
        from importlib.metadata import metadata
        meta = metadata('urllib3')
        requires_python = meta['Requires-Python']
        # 2.7.0 requires >=3.10, so on 3.9 this should have failed at install
        # We assert the requires-python is compatible with 3.9
        import packaging.specifiers
        spec = packaging.specifiers.SpecifierSet(requires_python)
        assert sys.version_info[:2] >= (3, 10) or packaging.version.Version('3.9') in spec, \
            'urllib3 2.7.0 does not support Python 3.9'
